steps.en: Writes a config and an example test, and downloads its Chromium, Firefox and WebKit builds
steps.zh: 生成配置和示例测试，下载三种浏览器引擎的构建

steps.en: Write tests with user-facing locators and web-first assertions
steps.zh: 用面向用户的定位器和自动重试的断言写测试

steps.en: Run the suite locally or in CI
steps.zh: 在本地或 CI 里运行整套测试

steps.en: Runs tests in parallel across the configured browsers, each in a fresh browser context
steps.zh: 在配置的各浏览器上并行跑测试，每个测试一个全新浏览器上下文

steps.en: Waits for each element to be actionable and retries assertions until they pass or time out
steps.zh: 等每个元素可操作，断言反复重试直到通过或超时

value.en: One suite covers Chromium, Firefox and WebKit without hand-written sleeps, and failures come with traces you can replay
value.zh: 一套测试覆盖 Chromium、Firefox、WebKit，不用手写 sleep，失败时还有可回放的 trace

sources: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/main/README.md Playwright Test (npm init playwright@latest, getByRole example, npx playwright test, auto-wait, test isolation, tracing, parallelism)
https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/main/docs/src/browsers.md (each version needs specific browser builds; patched Firefox/WebKit; install-deps)
